subject: Roadshow: regional spring roadshow — spend cap, PO & vendor advance
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Roadshow: regional spring roadshow — spend cap, PO & vendor advance

Hi team,

We need a quick approval to lock dates with Pacific Event Services for the West Coast roadshow (SF, Portland, Seattle) the week of June 21–25. Summary below:

- Vendor: Pacific Event Services (attached quote: pacific_quote_3pg.pdf)
- Proposed spend cap (initial): $38,500 (venue + base A/V + logistics)
- Vendor requests a 50% non-refundable deposit to hold dates: $19,250
- Cost center / GL: MKT-OP-4201
- Event code: MKT-RD-2026-05

Attachments: roadshow_budget_v2.xlsx, pacific_quote_3pg.pdf

Asks:
1) Approve spend cap and advance deposit so procurement can issue PO/submit to accounting.
2) Confirm cost center and that we can charge against Q2 trade show / events budget.
3) If any additional spend expected (extra A/V, furniture rentals), flag now so we can set final cap.

If I don't hear objections by EOD today I'll ask Procurement to start PO and request vendor W-9 and insurance cert. This timeline matters: vendor needs deposit within 72 hours to hold rooms.

Thanks —
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Roadshow: regional spring roadshow — spend cap, PO & vendor advance

Thanks Grace —

Approve the initial $38,500 spend cap and the 50% deposit. Please confirm the final cost center: is MKT-OP-4201 the correct one? Also confirm this will come out of Q2 events budget (we have ~150k remaining there).

Quick note: if Jordan flags more AV, please update the cap before PO creation. Otherwise proceed with procurement.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 13:20:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Roadshow: regional spring roadshow — spend cap, PO & vendor advance

Quick add — I reviewed the quote. We need to bump the AV line to include two additional mics and a livestream mix for the SF stop (audience expected ~450). That increases AV by ~$6,000.

If procurement can hold the PO cap at $44,500 (new total) I approve the spend; otherwise keep it at the original cap and we'll scope down A/V. Diego — can you confirm budget availability for $44.5k?

-JB
Jordan Blake
Head of Partnerships (acting)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 09:47:08 -0700
Subject: Re: Roadshow: regional spring roadshow — spend cap, PO & vendor advance

Thanks for the details. Procurement can process a PO and forward to Finance for payment, but I need the following before we can commit to a 50% advance: 

- Vendor W-9 (or local tax form)
- Certificate of insurance (vendor COI)
- Signed SOW or statement of work (scope + milestone/payment schedule)
- Final approved spend cap and cost center (confirm whether $44,500 or $38,500)

Once those items are attached to the PR I can create PO-PR and estimate PO creation by EOD Thu (6 May) if approvals are in place. Please note: finance-ops@redwood.com will require the PO number on the invoice for payment.

Diego Fernandez
Senior Procurement Specialist
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 14:50:01 -0700
Subject: RE: Roadshow: regional spring roadshow — spend cap, PO & vendor advance

Hi Grace / Diego —

Thanks for the update. We can hold the dates with a 50% deposit. Attached is the provisional invoice (invoice_advance_123.pdf) and bank wiring details; the deposit must clear within 72 hours to guarantee the venues.

I've also attached a redlined SOW for your review (signed_sow.pdf will follow once your legal has confirmed). We can provide a W-9 and COI immediately — see links below.

Attachments: invoice_advance_123.pdf

PO details: PO-2026-4398 (Ariba link: https://ariba.redwood.com/PO/PO-2026-4398)
